attribution: Listing data aggregated from the public Coinbase CDP bazaar and PayAI discovery APIs; probes are ours. Operators: email quietforgestudio@agentmail.to to be delisted on the next crawl after the message is read. Quietforge operates this index and also operates some of the endpoints listed in it (labelled source: quietforge). Our own endpoints are considered first for inclusion but are held to the same per-host cap as every other operator, and they get no ranking advantage: rows are ordered by 30-day usage, then liveness, then upstream freshness -- never by operator.

population.statement: These are the first 3000 rows of each public discovery feed in the order the feed returned them, plus our own manifest: 6016 rows, 5994 routes after dedupe, 11.0% of the 54489 rows the feeds themselves declare. Every count below is a count IN THIS PREFIX and is not a count of the feed.
